text: Super Comfortable Bed. This bed is very comfortable. I love laying and sleeping on it. I always feel well rested after waking up.

product_metadata.title: Vesgantti Twin XL Mattress, 12 Inch Innerspring Hybrid Twin XL Size Mattress with Memory Foam and Individual Pocket Springs, Mattress in a Box, Medium Firm Feel
features: 【Vesgantti Lavender Mattress】- The mattress features a lavender stretch knit cover with innovative polyester mesh sides to keep air flowing freely and promote cooling, helping to regulate body temperature for a comfortable night's sleep

【Balance Support】- The 7-zone individual pocketed springs are designed to adapt to your body's curves, providing you with balanced head-to-toe support, helping to release pressure on each part of the body in any sleep positions
【Restful Sleep】- Vesgantti mattress have hundreds of pocket springs that work independently, which can minimizing motion transfer from your partner and give you a quiet sleep experience
【Medium Firm Feel】- This hybrid mattress combines multilayer foam and pocket springs for a balance of soft and firm, offering a medium-firm feel that's suitable for most people
【Mattress in a Box】- Vesgantti mattress is compressed and roll-packed in a box that's shipped right to your door. Our mattresses will expand in minutes and get its full size in 72 hours
